This is not a traditional account management role.
You’ll be responsible for managing hiring processes from kickoff through successful placement by partnering directly with clients, sourcing and evaluating top talent, coordinating interviews, negotiating offers, and ensuring a seamless experience for both clients and candidates.

• Experience

• Communication

• Cultural fit

• Continuously improve recruitment workflows and candidate experience.

• High-quality candidates are presented quickly.

• Hiring timelines are consistently met.

• Clients receive proactive communication and exceptional service.

• Candidates remain engaged throughout the hiring process.

• Recruitment pipelines stay organized and accurate.

• Placements lead to long-term client satisfaction and repeat business.

• You enjoy owning the hiring process from beginning to end.

Founded in the US in 2022 and now based in London, UK, Recraft is an AI tool for professional designers, illustrators, and marketers, setting a new standard for excellence in image generation.

We designed a tool that lets creators quickly generate and iterate original images, vector art, illustrations, icons, and 3D graphics with AI. Over 3 million users across 190+ countries have produced hundreds of millions of images using Recraft, and we're just getting started.

Join a universe of professional opportunities, develop and support large-scale projects, and shape the future of creativity. We are committed to making Recraft an essential, daily tool for every designer and setting the industry standard. Our mission is to ensure that creators can fully control their creative process with AI, providing them with innovative tools to turn ideas into reality.

If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI, we want you on board!

JOB DESCRIPTION

Growth at Recraft runs on creative that's tested, not guessed at. We're looking for a Performance Creative Designer who can take that on as their own: reading what's working, turning that into the next round of ads, and shipping creative that holds up on Meta, Google, and TikTok. For the right person, this is a chance to build the performance creative function at Recraft from the ground up, with Recraft Studio itself as your day-to-day production tool.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Produce paid ad creative - static, motion, and UGC-style edits - for Meta, Google, and TikTok.

- Own the creative testing pipeline end to end: form a hypothesis, ship it, read the results, and iterate on winners.

- Translate performance data (hook rate, CTR) into the next round of creative yourself, rather than waiting for a brief.

- Use Recraft Studio as your primary production tool, and feed what you learn back to the product team building it.

- Keep the ad creative brandbook consistent while adapting tone by placement and audience.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll join the Marketing team and work closely with our Performance Marketing Manager, UA Manager, and Creative and product teams. This is a role built around bringing your own ideas to the table, not just executing against a detailed brief.

REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years creating performance and paid-acquisition creative.

- A portfolio of ads that actually ran, with context on what won and why.

- Comfortable with both static and motion work: Figma or Photoshop, plus After Effects, Premiere, or CapCut.

- Strong understanding of ad anatomy - hooks, the first three seconds, text hierarchy, platform specs, and policy limits.

- Hands-on experience using AI image or video tools in a real production workflow.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with design tools, creative SaaS, or dev tools (Canva, Picsart, Photoroom, Figma-adjacent products).

- Vector or 3D skills - a real differentiator given Recraft's vector and brand-style capabilities.

- Ad copywriting - able to write your own headlines and hooks.

You will solve challenging problems arising from real sensor systems-including imperfect time synchronisation, rolling-shutter cameras and LiDAR sweep patterns-and develop robust methods that operate across diverse vehicles, environments and operating conditions. You will collaborate broadly across Wayve and provide technical leadership and mentorship across the 3D sensing stack.

• Define and evolve the technical architecture and roadmap for Wayve’s LiDAR and cross-sensor 3D sensing capabilities, aligned with product and vehicle-programme requirements.

• Lead the development of target-based and targetless LiDAR calibration and registration methods, including LiDAR-to-camera alignment using geometric and learned approaches.

• Establish evaluation methodologies and productionise reliable, scalable 3D sensing systems that operate across diverse vehicles, environments and sensor configurations.

• Work with engineering and research teams to deliver end-to-end 3D sensing capabilities, while providing technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers.

Essential 

• Significant experience developing robotics or autonomous-driving systems involving LiDAR, cameras and 3D sensor data.

• Strong experience with target-based or targetless sensor calibration and registration, including LiDAR-to-camera alignment.

• Strong understanding of 3D geometry, state estimation and optimisation techniques, including nonlinear least-squares methods or factor graphs.

• Experience accounting for sensor timing and motion effects, such as time synchronisation, LiDAR sweep distortion, rolling-shutter cameras and motion compensation.

• Strong software-engineering skills in C++ and/or Python, with experience taking robotics algorithms from prototype through evaluation and production deployment.

• Experience defining evaluation methodologies, datasets and metrics for assessing calibration, registration and 3D sensing quality across real-world conditions.
